name: Bahçe Salyangozu
scene: A garden snail with a large concentric spiral shell rests among flowing leaves and sky bands.
notes: Design sheet only; target 70–110 panes. Snail shell, body and antennae use the warm pair; garden and sky use the cool pair. Referenced vitray_fox.png and vitray_poppies.png for style and inspected the old snail artwork for subject. Generated with clai image and visually checked; regenerated once to simplify junctions and make the exterior white. Remaining doubts for tracing: crowded contacts above the shell and at the lower foliage, possible four-way contacts within the body, some same-colour neighbours, and subtle residual fill variation. No obvious loose line ends. Pane count and junction compliance are not geometry-audited. Both generations recorded with action-log.
